# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/LightSideKittens/LightSideEcosystem/security/advisories/new). Do not disclose them in public issues, pull requests or on Discord.

Include the affected product and version, the impact and the steps to reproduce.

## Leaked access tokens

An access token grants access to licensed products. Treat any token that appeared in a public place as compromised and contact unity@lightside.media for a replacement.

Tokens posted in this repository's issues and comments are hidden automatically and revoked by a maintainer. The original text stays in the edit history until the maintainer deletes that revision.
